blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Leptospirosis cases in the country fell 46% over a two-week period in September, suggesting that the surge in infections may be easing, according to a report by the Department of Health (DOH). The DOH recorded 1,814 cases from Sept. 10 to 23, down from 3,340 cases reported from Aug. 27 to Sept. 9. Despite the decline, the country recorded 13,158 cases as of Oct. 7, up 48% from the 8,910 cases recorded during the same period in 2025.
